selection.selection_rule: Eligible all-clear audited candidates only; minimum (max(two means), average(two means), label).
selection.scope: All four complete development batches retained, including failed cases/audits. No R25 trigger-count gate. 500 is an investment gate, not 460 achievement or final promotion.

mechanism_scope: Only accepted action history and row costs. Phase movement is incoming travel to an action, not an isolated counterfactual route cost.

stratified_bootstrap.limitation: Within-stratum empirical resampling only. Singleton strata have no estimable within-stratum variation; zero interval width is not certainty.
